claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Hydrastinine is a minor goldenseal alkaloid with no reported antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any effects limited to weak DNA damage or phototoxicity requiring UVA, not relevant in a standard 5-day viability screen.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Hydrastinine is a minor goldenseal alkaloid with no reported antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any effects limited to weak DNA damage or phototoxicity requiring UVA, not relevant in a standard 5-day viability screen.
